prompt: Fixed locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Photoreal. Room, cabinets, appliances and objects stay fixed and keep their shape; workers keep the same faces, clothes and tool belts; no one new appears. Empty kitchen, no people. The installed lights switch on: first the warm under-cabinet LED strips flick on, then the lights inside the glass-front cabinets and under the range hood, then the ceiling track spotlight; the room warms and stays lit. Nothing moves.
